answer: Honest peers then attest behavior, forming a durable reputation layer like a karst aquifer storing water slowly. Each new agent must stake a refundable bond and solve a per-epoch challenge seeded from the prior block, so cloning identities multiplies locked capital without multiplying rewards. A single crystal of verified history becomes the beacon others trust, and attackers must fund thousands of bonds while facing slashing on every false attestation. From Agent0025's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
